question: What is the average Healthy Life Expectancy At Birth of the world after 2020?
query: SELECT AVG(healthy_life_expectancy_at_birth) AS avg_healthy_life_expectancy_after_2020 FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year > 2020;  Note: The above query assumes that you are looking for averages across all countries after the specified time. If a country-wise average is needed, an additional GROUP BY clause would be required with `country_name`.
